## not-converging

Escalated to a person: not converging. Its actions: retry, accept, amend, stop. Only the person decides: explain and propose (the banner works too). Ask with ask_person; offer only actions that need no note as choices. A free answer of the owner lets you decide_escalation. Findings: fnd_1, fnd_2. Their criteria remain unmet after consecutive fixes, or fixes keep causing new blockers. Another fixer is not started without direction: retry needs how to fix differently, accept needs the risk accepted, and amend needs the intended behaviour that replaces the named criteria, all in the person's own words.

## stuck

Escalated to a person: stuck. Its actions: retry, accept, stop. Only the person decides: explain and propose (the banner works too). Ask with ask_person; offer only actions that need no note as choices. A free answer of the owner lets you decide_escalation. Retry needs the person's direction for the next fix, not a bare choice.
